Proposed Process

Admission Process

Four straightforward steps to embark on your child's joyful preschool journey.

Note: Proposed admission process; specific steps may vary upon school confirmation.
🚌
Step 01

Explore Our Programs

Learn about our Playgroup, Nursery, LKG and UKG offerings to choose the best developmental fit for your child.

Step 02

Submit an Enquiry

Fill out our online form or give us a quick call with your child's details and any specific questions you have.

Step 03

Connect With Our Team

Our friendly admissions coordinator will connect with you to discuss the curriculum and arrange an optional campus walkthrough.

Step 04

Complete Formalities

Complete registration and receive your welcome kit. Your little one officially joins the loving InnoTots family!

Common Inquiries

Frequently Asked Questions

Clear answers to common questions prospective families ask about InnoTots Preschool.

We offer four age-appropriate learning programs: Playgroup (typically 1.5–2.5 years), Nursery (typically 2.5–3.5 years), Lower Kindergarten / LKG (typically 3.5–4.5 years), and Upper Kindergarten / UKG (typically 4.5–5.5 years). Each program is carefully tailored to support every child's stage of early development.
